newsitem.title: USA: Clark Blue Island, Ill plant units shut til ruling.
newsitem.headline: Clark Blue Island, Ill plant units shut til ruling.

text.p: Clark Refining & Marketing will have to keep units at its Blue Island, Illinois refinery shut until a ruling is reached on closing the plant completely on safety grounds, a judge said Monday.

Cook county circuit court judge Albert Green said the units, a propane "scrubber" and an alcylation unit which were shut nine days ago by a fire, would have to remain shut until he rules on the case on November 8.
The court is hearing a case brought by the Illinois attorney general to shut the plant until a full safety investigation can be completed following three incidents in the past 18 months.
